## Highlights

- The CLI release lane now builds from the same source-bound workflow contract as service images, so native binaries and their release tag cannot silently come from different commits.
- Release metadata and image identity checks now exercise the exact prepared source SHA used by the publication job.

## Upgrade notes

- Adopt v0.5.86 as one source-bound cohort through the normal Ops release workflow. It supersedes v0.5.85 for the managed deployment CLI and runtime; no database migration or manual configuration change is required.
